$description: Product status scale — INDEPENDENT of brand accents (mint/violet/amber) by contract. Never alias status to a brand accent. Always convey status with ICON + TEXT, never colour alone. Dark-surface variants; AA-tuned (BRAND-RECONCILIATION.md §5-A + contrast check). `fill` pairs with `ink` (dark) on a pill; `on-dark` is the readable text/icon colour on archive/midnight surfaces.

ink.$description: Text/icon ON the success fill (dark ink).

on-dark.$description: Success text/icon on a dark surface.

ink.$description: Text/icon ON the warning fill (dark ink).

on-dark.$description: Warning text/icon on a dark surface.

fill.$description: Danger pill fill (white text failed 3.73 → dark ink 5.21).

ink.$description: Text/icon ON the danger fill (dark ink, 5.21).

on-dark.$description: Danger text/icon on a dark surface.
